description: Unit Tests - Create comprehensive Jest unit tests for all core modules, Joule integration, and TLA+ export. Target >80% coverage on new code.
steps: 1. Create test/core/path-explorer.test.js - Test explorePaths() with simple machine, test checkInvariants() with passing and failing invariants, test runMBT() end-to-end, test loop detection, test maxDepth/maxPaths limits.

2. Create test/core/invariant-builder.test.js - Test createInvariant() with valid config, test error on missing name/check, test fromPredicate(), test combine(), test when() conditional invariants, test bound() numeric bounds, test validateInvariant().

3. Create test/invariants/index.test.js - Test each built-in invariant with scenarios: budgetRespected (under/over budget), retriesBounded (within/exceeds retries), noInvalidCompletion (valid/invalid completion), escalationHasReason (with/without reason), dataConsistent (matching/mismatching counts).

4. Create test/joule/machine-extractor.test.js - Test extractMachine() with mock CDS content containing @agent annotation, test extractFromDefinition() with service definition object, test edge cases (missing annotations, empty services).

5. Create test/joule/react-templates.test.js - Test createReActMachine() produces valid machine with expected states, test createA2AMachine() produces valid machine, test createHITLMachine() produces valid machine, test createSubagentMachine() produces valid machine. Verify each machine can be used with runMBT().

6. Create test/tla/spec-generator.test.js - Test generateTLASpec() output contains required TLA+ elements (MODULE, VARIABLE, Init, Next, Spec), test invariant conversion, test with multi-state machine, test special characters in state names are handled.
7. Create test/cli/init.test.js - Test init() creates expected directory structure, test --force overwrites existing files, test --template option for agent/workflow/migration templates.
8. Create test/cli/run.test.js - Test run() finds machine files, test --machine filter, test --verbose output, test --report generates HTML file.
acceptance_criteria: All test files exist in test/ directory with proper structure
npm test runs all tests without errors
Coverage report shows >80% coverage on lib/core/, lib/joule/, lib/tla/ (excluding index.js re-exports)
Tests cover both success and failure paths for each function
verification: Run: npm test - all tests should pass
